explanation: The 'work' is the main course, so these small dishes stand apart from it. The Italian antipasto, meaning 'before the meal', names the same course another way.

claims.text: Hors d'oeuvre means literally 'outside the work' in French.
Hors d'oeuvre does not mean before the meal, small bites or open the mouth.
In hors d'oeuvre, the 'work' refers to the main part of the meal.
The Italian antipasto means 'before the meal'.
